plain: Forcing men to serve in a navy or army.

webster.text: The act of impressing men into public service; as the impressment of seamen.

more.text: The act of compelling into any service; as the impressment of nurses to attend the sick.
The act of seizing for public use; as the impressment of provisions for the army.

example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 13, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
